newsitem.title: CANADA: Onex unit completes initial offering.
newsitem.headline: Onex unit completes initial offering.

text.p: Onex Corp said on Tuesday that its ProSource Inc food service subsidiary completed an initial public offering of 3.4 million common shares at US$14 a share.
"The net proceeds from the offering will be used to reduce existing indebtedness of ProSource and pursue growth objectives," Onex said.

Onex said it acquired an additional 500,000 shares of ProSource as part of the offering, increasing its total ProSource holding to 5.6 million shares. Onex said its stake, based on the offer price, was worth C$104 million.

Onex said its equity ownership in ProSource was diluted to 59 percent from 84 percent because of the share issue. But its voting interest in ProSource is higher due to its holding of multiple voting shares.
Onex stock was up 0.35 at 16.15 in afternoon turnover of 30,000 shares on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
